# Focusi

> Focusi makes wobble stools, visual timers, and free downloadable planners that help kids with ADHD, autism, and sensory needs stay focused, regulated, and engaged at home and in the classroom.

Focusi is a small kids-focus brand. Our products combine ergonomic active seating with calming sensory input, and our content library helps parents and teachers build routines, manage screen time, and support executive function.

## Pages

- [Free Planners](/): Downloadable PDF planners, routines, and visual schedules for kids and parents.
- [Shop](/shop): Wobble stools and visual timer cubes designed for focus and movement.
- [Why Focusi](/why-focusi): The story and design philosophy behind our products.
- [Research](/research-based): The science of active seating, movement, and child focus.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles for parents on ADHD, sensory needs, focus, and learning.
- [Memory Game](/memory-game): A free in-browser memory game for kids.
